Outlets Focus on Home Remedies for Skin Care

Multiple Indian media outlets are featuring content on homemade face masks and natural skincare remedies. The articles highlight the benefits of ingredients like chia seeds for skin health, suggesting them as alternatives to chemical-based products. This coverage appears in right-leaning Hindi publications.
